subject: Weekly forecast submission & ops handoff — call agenda and evidence packs
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly forecast submission & ops handoff — call agenda and evidence packs

Team — quick weekly reminder and agenda for today’s 3:00 PM PST commit check (calendar invite sent). This is the final submission window for the week: please treat as high priority. Key asks below so we can keep the call <30m and lock numbers.

Prework (due by 2:00 PM PST):
- Update stage flags in Salesforce for any change since yesterday (especially ACME Analytics and DeltaBridge).
- Upload evidence files to the shared drive folder and mark items in Q2_evidence_list.xlsx (attached).
- Confirm commit amount in the commit-deck-v2.pptx (deck slide 3) and add short rationale if any movement.

Call agenda (15–20m):
1) Quick rollcall and lane owners (2m)
2) Top 6 priority accounts — commit check and blockers (8m)
   - ACME Analytics (Priyom) — procurement evidence outstanding
   - Nucleus Health — legal redline in flight
3) Evidence escrow and turn-in process (5m)
4) Any escalations to Rev Ops / Finance (3m)

Deliverables after call (by EOD):
- Finalized commit numbers pushed to forecasts (owner: lane owner).
- Evidence folder marked as COMPLETE (owner: evidence lead).
- Any deals with procurement asks flagged for CS escalation.

Notes: I’m looping procurement contact at ACME this morning to confirm their checklist; I expect one ask (SOC2 attestation PDF) that we should be able to drop into the evidence folder. Priyom — can you own the ACME thread and confirm upload?

Thanks — see you at 3.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
